label: main season
summary: Recommend cancellation by non-technical survey for sign-off. E1 and E2 are reports from two different first-hand sources, each supporting at least 5 years of safe use (13 years); the register contains no direct or target indirect evidence, and the decision check passes the national criteria. The nearest recorded accident is 1–3 km away, not inside this area.
flags: The zone survey flag and survey-priority rank identify where to visit; they are not evidence about the area.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
There is no direct evidence and no indirect evidence of class 1 to 4, and every item of weaker indirect evidence is explained by evidence of absence of class 1 to 4.
2 different reliable source(s) report at least 5 years of safe use (E1; E2); the criteria need 2.
No past landmine accident is recorded inside the area.

E1.quote: she has walked the trail across the area to the school every year for the past 13 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E1.note: First-hand land user reports recurring safe passage through the area over 13 years; this supports absence.

E2.quote: the board has recorded no find or accident in the area in the 13 years she has held the post, and that families use land in the area every week.
E2.note: The board president reports weekly use of the area and no findings or accidents over 13 years; this supports absence.
